jobs.description: At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. Apply today and help us transform the future of eye health.This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.This position can be filled either as Principal Scientist or Senior Principal Scientist.This position has a hybrid setup with approximately 1 - 2 days per week on site.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you will be accountable for the development and implementation of end-to-end translational biomarker strategies from the preclinical to clinical early and late phases of drug development programs.- You will lead as a matrix leader biomarker- related activities from quantifying drug response on molecular pathways and imaging biomarkers and drives efforts to link these to impact on disease trajectories, functional assessments and patient benefit in relevant disease populations.- Furthermore, you will assume accountability for research collaborations focused on benefiting multiple programs in line clinical development plans by delivering fit for purpose biomarker strategies that drive decisions making and inform preclinical and drug development plans- Finally, you will collaborate with internal enable filing of novel and differentiated MoAs in our core indications.Requirements- PhD and/or MD degree with long term experience in research, industry or clinical setting, including several years activities to achieve both project objectives and team deliverables.- Strong expertise in methodological, bioanalytical, and clinical assessments within translational and clinical development with a deep understanding of biomarker applications across the drug development lifecycle.
